environment: CPython 3.11.9; Windows 11 Pro; short dedicated C: TEMP per sample
freshness: Each attempt is a separate interpreter process with a fresh server, owner, producer, call/operation IDs, recovery receipt, Fake observer receipts, effect fixture, and task-oracle attempt. Each attempt uses a unique short TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR path under C:\Users\user\AppData\Local\Temp.
pass_rule: An attempt passes only on exit 0 and unittest OK with all frozen assertions. Every failure remains in the denominator; no retry or replacement.
required_assertions: exact Fake callback/public observation ID receipt match
lower real observer open_session guard untouched
exact task oracle operation and target generation
separate recovery release and matching horizon
all accepted Futures/reports drained before close
prior_context: R04 7/10 used the prior candidate and default D: temp path. R16/R19/R20/R22 show strong temp-location effects. R23 tests whether the merged observer binding and short C: temp path improve this Fake-only lifecycle cohort.
scope: Fake/local public-MCP recovery lifecycle repeatability only
